note: Test reply (illustrative, not history): a fever keeps him to his bed from the 25th to the 28th; Harrach and Starhemberg call on the 26th, Bartenstein (cool) on the 27th. Load with __w3d.mockReply('fever').

changes.title: A fever
changes.briefing: A fever took you on the 25th. The physician bled you twice and kept you abed until the 28th; the business of the court came to your bedside, or waited.

whereabouts.doing: calling at your bedside on the Conference's business
come for your signature, and in no hurry to leave

reports.title: The physician's opinion
reports.text: Your physician finds a tertian fever and orders rest, broth and quiet. He will bleed you tomorrow if it does not break.

reports.title: The Conference comes to you
reports.text: Count Harrach and Count Starhemberg have come in person: the Conference will not wait on your fever. They bring the question of the Silesian garrisons.

reports.title: On your feet
reports.text: The fever has broken. You are weak, but the physician allows you out of bed.

hidden.chronicle: Test chronicle: a fever in late October.

dossier.note: Wrote of “The Conference comes to you”.
